description: This Java source file defines the class 'HonoCommander' which manages the creation of command clients, sending commands, and handling responses in the context of an Eclipse Hono IoT communication framework. It interacts with Hono connections, manages message consumers, and tracks command success/failure metrics. The class is integral to a JMeter test setup, facilitating command issuance and response measurement for devices.

classes.name: HonoCommander
classes.description: Manages connection, messaging, and command exchange with devices via Hono, integrated with JMeter for performance testing. Provides methods for starting, sampling, and shutting down.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Establishes connection to Hono and creates message consumers asynchronously.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Executes a sample operation, sending commands to devices based on trigger type and recording success/error metrics.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes connections and cleans up resources.

methods.name: createMessageConsumers
methods.description: Sets up message consumers for events and telemetry in Hono.

methods.name: handleCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Handles device readiness notifications for command sending.

methods.name: sendCommandAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends command to device and handles the response.

methods.name: closeCommandClient
methods.description: Closes the command client and logs closure.

methods.name: setSampleStartAndEndTime
methods.description: Records timing information for a sample.

methods.name: setSampleStartIfNotSetYet
methods.description: Sets start time for sampling if not already set.
